name: mutation-lock-race
body: Durable spec authoring must be reliable under concurrency. Today a burst of `apg node` / `apg edge` mutations issued in parallel fails with lbug's exclusive file-lock error ("Could not set lock … Resource temporarily unavailable") for roughly half the calls, so the authoring agent must retry strictly serially. This tree captures the why, the root cause, the durable-state invariants, the fix ladder, and the optional session-scoped mutation coordinator. Decomposed into the seven child requirements below: root-cause-before-fix, concurrent-bursts-reliable, durable-state-authoritative, db-rebuildable-projection, evaluate-fix-ladder, lock-race-acceptance, and session-mutation-coordinator.
